harper: Quick flag: our Next edge sample started exploding in size after upgrading to @redwood-inference/sdk@1.8.0 and now the worker errors out during startup.

vik: what error do you see in the worker?

harper: runtime throws (in Vercel worker): "ReferenceError: process is not defined" and also some calls expect globalThis.crypto.subtle but the bundle added a node-crypto shim instead. Analyzer shows large chunks from lodash + node-libs-shim under @redwood-inference/sdk/dist/shims.

sam: how are you importing the SDK in the edge file?

harper: `import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk'` in middleware.ts. bundle inspector shows index.js at package root doing `module.exports = require('./dist/index.cjs.js')` so esbuild ends up pulling CJS surface.

vik: aha. that CJS proxy defeats tree-shaking and causes bundlers to include node polyfills. short-term for app devs: use the explicit ESM path: `import { createClient } from '@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.esm.js'` or dynamic import inside runtime to avoid packing node shims.

harper: tried explicit ESM import — runtime works but TS types for default import break for some consumers. We're seeing a mix of breakage reports.

pack-bot: :warning: bundle-regression detected for /edge-sample (delta +142KB). artifact: https://ci.internal/artifacts/edge/1774205555.html

sam: SDK team action items I recommend: 1) add conditional exports in package.json ("import"->esm, "require"->cjs) 2) set "sideEffects": false (with allowlist for any runtime files that really have side-effects) 3) ensure any `require('node:crypto')` or `require('fs')` are moved into function bodies (lazy require) 4) run `npm pack` locally and inspect published tarball for stray CJS wrappers or map files.

vik: also add CI smoke tests: pack the published tarball and run bundler smoke-tests (esbuild, rollup, webpack) against a tiny edge fixture and fail release if process/Buffer strings or node-libs entries appear in bundle.

harper: typings corner: when we change exports, make sure "types" points to `dist/index.d.ts` and that .d.ts exposes both default and named exports so TS consumers don't have to enable esModuleInterop. Add a TS compatibility test to avoid pushing devs to flip compiler flags.

sam: docs/changelog: add a short note in the 1.8.1 changelog telling edge/worker/Deno users to use the explicit ESM path until we ship the fix to reduce support noise. Also update the devex edge guide with a small example and bundler gotchas checklist.

docs: I'll draft the docs blurb and include a minimal Next middleware snippet. will link to the repro artifact.

harper: opened issue with analyzer and a tiny repro: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/512 - assigning to @sdk-team and milestone 1.8.1. Will PR the sample-app to the explicit esm import as a temporary mitigation.

pack-bot: :white_check_mark: reproducible artifact uploaded and linked to issue 512.
